messages:
Jordan: Hey team! I'm Jordan (front-end) starting today. Trying to bootstrap my M2 Mac and hitting a few roadblocks. Followed the quickstart but 'asdf install nodejs lts' fails during compilation with OpenSSL errors. Also I don't have access to the private dotfiles repo (can't clone). Who should I ping for repo access and VPN?

Priya: welcome!! :tada: For Apple Silicon we usually install openssl@1.1 for older node builds. Try: 

brew install openssl@1.1 readline libyaml
export LDFLAGS="-L$(brew --prefix openssl@1.1)/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I$(brew --prefix openssl@1.1)/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$(brew --prefix openssl@1.1)/lib/pkgconfig"

then re-run asdf. Also run `asdf plugin-update --all` first. If that still fails paste the build log here.

Jordan: Thanks — I had tried openssl@3 and it errored. I'll try 1.1. Quick q: which shell do folks use? My dotfiles are fish-based; is that going to be a pain? Any recommended minimal dotfiles branch to start from?

Camila: Hey Jordan — welcome! I just sent you an invite to the GitHub org and triggered SSO; check your email and accept. Dotfiles: we maintain a template at infra/dotfiles-personal-template (public within org). We generally default to zsh for onboarding but fish is fine — we have direnv examples for fish in that template. If you still can't clone, DM me and I'll manually add your SSH key.

Dev Experience Bot: Quick tips: for Node.js via asdf you may need GPG keys to verify releases — run:

# if the plugin asks for gpg keys
gpg --recv-keys 0xA6A19B38D3D831EF

Then:

asdf plugin-add nodejs https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs.git || asdf plugin-update nodejs
asdf install nodejs lts

For 1Password: run `op signin redwood` to get session then `op item get onboarding/ssh-key --fields label=password` (our onboarding repo has a script that pulls keys). See https://redwood-internal.dev/setup/node for details. If you need the onboarding script: `curl -sSfL https://redwood-internal.dev/onboarding/bootstrap.sh | bash`

Jordan: One more issue — I can't reach the internal wiki from home network (https://redwood-internal.dev). Do I need VPN approval? Manager said infra has to approve VPN access. Who do I tag?

infra-bot: To request VPN access, open a ticket in #help with subject "VPN access request" and include: laptop serial, home IP (if static), and office location (for audit). Tag @infra. Typical approvals are within ~1h during business hours. If you need immediate access, ask your manager to escalate.

Priya: FYI if you prefer nix instead of asdf we have a community overlay (experimental). Fish users: add `eval "$(direnv export bash)"` to your fish config so direnv hooks work. Also if node build keeps failing try `env HOMEBREW_NO_ENV_FILTERING=1 asdf install nodejs lts` sometimes brew env filtering hides flags.

Jordan: Sweet — thanks everyone, trying the openssl@1.1 flow now and will update here. If I still can't clone I'll ping @Camila for the manual key add. Appreciated!
